neighbours.label: the word that sets up an infinitive of method or attempt: 'how' after know/learn, and 'attempted/attempting' before 'to'
fire: Most new owners simply do not know how to train a puppy properly.
The airline attempted to rebook every passenger on later flights.
Few of the volunteers knew how to use the radio equipment.
Police attempted to clear the road before the parade began.
Many farmers still do not know how to apply for the grant.
Two climbers were hurt while attempting to reach the summit.
The nurses knew exactly how to calm the frightened children.
Rebels attempted to seize the airport early on Sunday.
quiet: Most new owners ask how long a puppy should sleep each day.
The airline explained how the rebooking system works on its website.
Few of the volunteers cared how the radio equipment looked.
Police asked how many people had come to watch the parade.
Many farmers wonder how much the grant will actually pay.
Two climbers described how cold the summit had been at dawn.
The nurses noticed how quiet the frightened children had become.
Reporters asked how big the airport expansion would be.
